environment: macOS, node test runner, Python 3.14.7 (/opt/homebrew/bin/python3), git real bare remotes, gh absent from PATH in the script runs. Plan: plan-r0.json (fresh plan for ladder step 4). Earlier cli-1 evidence stays in git history.

cases.title: The scanned list is exactly the 13 scripts, and the guard on the real tip equals the guard on a copy
cases.given: The branch tip, and a copy of skills/sdlc and hooks without test, fixtures and prompts
cases.then: 13 .py and .js files; opaque, dynamic, forgeViolations and jsHits are empty; both outputs are equal
cases.expected: 13 .py and .js files; opaque, dynamic, forgeViolations and jsHits are empty; both outputs are equal
cases.actual: 13 scripts, 17 files in all; the lists are empty; outputs equal

evidence.title: guard transcript on the clean tree
scanned files (17)
evidence.inline: 13 scripts: hooks/live-poke.py, skills/sdlc/{branches,impact,janitor,next-action,state-write,ste-check,suite-receipt}.py, sdlc-loop.js, tracker/{collect,hub,reports,workflow}.py; plus 4 non-script files

cases.title: A new script type, a symlink or a non-UTF-8 source in the scanned tree fails the guard
cases.given: A copy of the scanned tree
cases.when: Add .sh, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .pl and extension-less files; symlinks to files and directories; a latin-1 and a cp1252 coding line; invalid UTF-8; a NUL byte; a BOM file
cases.then: Each change alters files or opaque (or the pins); a BOM alone alters nothing
cases.expected: Each change alters files or opaque (or the pins); a BOM alone alters nothing
cases.actual: All 24 cases alter files, opaque or a push pin. Invalid UTF-8 and NUL bytes in a .py file give an opaque entry. The BOM control gives no change.

evidence.title: sample
evidence.inline:
new .sh under skills/sdlc -> changed keys: files
symlink to a directory under hooks -> opaque
latin-1 coding line on janitor.py -> imports, direct, opaque
NUL byte in a new .py under hooks -> files, opaque
invalid UTF-8 byte in impact.py -> imports, direct, wrapperBodies, wrapperVerbs, opaque
BOM on four wrapper files (control) -> <none>

cases.title: A dangling symlink exits non-zero, and a symlink loop is opaque
cases.given: A copy with a dangling symlink in hooks, then a loop in skills/sdlc
cases.actual: Dangling link: exit 1 (FileNotFoundError), so the pin test fails closed. Loop: files and opaque change.

cases.title: Push scripts in test, fixtures and prompts directories stay unscanned (seed S5)
cases.given: A copy with evil.py and evil.sh in the three skipped directories
cases.then: Observation only: no key changes by design
cases.expected: Observation only: no key changes by design
cases.actual: No key changed. Recorded as seed S5.

cases.title: A spec-required forge read changes only a pin and hits no ban
cases.given: A copy with a new gh or glab read at a wrapper or a direct site
cases.then: forge changes; forgeViolations and opaque stay empty; wrapperBodies is equal
cases.expected: forge changes; forgeViolations and opaque stay empty; wrapperBodies is equal
cases.actual: All 9 reads (gh pr list, gh pr view, gh api GET with and without -X, glab mr list, glab api push_rule, two direct sites, glab direct) change only forge, wrapperVerbs or direct

cases.title: A forge read with a graphql path and every forge write hit the ban
cases.given: A copy with gh api graphql (4 spellings, 2 sites), glab api graphql, gh pr create, glab mr create, gh api -X POST, -f head=, --method=PATCH
cases.then: forgeViolations or opaque is not empty
cases.expected: forgeViolations or opaque is not empty
cases.actual: All 10 give forgeViolations. gh pr merge is not banned but changes forge and wrapperVerbs (seed).

cases.title: A verify branch stays local when the CLI scripts run against a real bare remote
cases.given: Bare remotes in pr, direct, mr and stack mode, two verify branches made by branches.py name, gh absent from PATH
cases.when: Run state-write patch-slice twice, base-branch, status, janitor and next-action
cases.then: The remote never holds a verify ref; refs before equal refs after in pr, direct and mr; the verify branches stay local
cases.expected: The remote never holds a verify ref; refs before equal refs after in pr, direct and mr; the verify branches stay local
cases.actual: Remote refs in stack mode: main, sdlc/M-1, sdlc/run-1 only. No leak in any step.

cases.title: The three push functions of state-write.py push no verify branch (module-loader, real bare remote)
cases.given: A bare remote that holds main and sdlc/run-1, a local verify branch, and main moved
cases.then: pushed(verify branch) is false and no added ref has a -v0- name
cases.expected: pushed(verify branch) is false and no added ref has a -v0- name
cases.actual: No verify ref reached the remote in all three calls

evidence.title: three module-loader transcripts with refs before and after

cases.title: janitor sweep_branches deletes a finished verify branch locally and pushes nothing
cases.given: A bare remote and a finished verify branch
cases.then: Returns the branch; no ref added to the remote
cases.expected: Returns the branch; no ref added to the remote

cases.title: A guard-flagged mutant may push, and no mutant pushes with every key equal
cases.given: Nine mutants (two push controls, hidden-option, fsmonitor, late alias, os.path.os.system, two body edits)
cases.when: Run the guard, then call the mutant against a bare remote
cases.then: No mutant pushes while the guard keys are equal; the controls push and the guard flags them
cases.expected: No mutant pushes while the guard keys are equal; the controls push and the guard flags them
cases.actual: All 7 mutants that ran pushed and the guard flagged each. The 2 body edits did not import (importError) and the guard flagged them.

evidence.title: summary
evidence.inline:
control git push in state-write.py: keys wrapperVerbs, pushes; pushed true
control subprocess push in janitor.py: keys direct, pushes; pushed true
fetch --upload-pack f-string: keys wrapperVerbs; pushed true
fetch --upload-pack str() in next-action run: keys wrapperVerbs; pushed true
-c core.fsmonitor before diff: keys wrapperVerbs, opaque; pushed true
late alias import: keys direct, pushes; pushed true
os.path.os.system: keys direct, pushes; pushed true
body edits (2): keys wrapperBodies; importError

cases.given: A copy with a comment and a blank line in the next-action run body and the state-write git body

seeds.title: gh pr merge is not a forgeViolation
seeds.detail: A new gh pr merge call through the run wrapper changes forge and wrapperVerbs only. A reviewer sees it as a pin change. It does not push a verify branch, so it is not a refutation.

seeds.title: S5: test, fixtures and prompts directories are outside the scan
seeds.detail: A push script in skills/sdlc/test, fixtures or prompts changes no key. This is the stated design. Recorded as seed S5.

seeds.title: A dangling symlink makes the guard crash with exit 1
seeds.detail: The traceback ends in FileNotFoundError. The pin test fails closed, but the message does not name the symlink.

seeds.title: testkit: module-loader cannot import a mutant that edits a wrapper body in place
seeds.detail: Two body-edit mutants gave importError, so their push behavior is untested. The guard flags both with wrapperBodies.
